t: What Robot Fleet Coordination Database Is All About
title: What Robot Fleet Coordination Database Is All About
description: Fleet coordination runs many robots as one system: task allocation (who does what — auction or optimization), traffic management (lanes, zones, deadlock avoidance), and communication (fleet manager, V2V). Warehouse AMRs (Kiva/Amazon: the pioneers) prove it at scale. The metrics: throughput, utilization, deadlock-free hours. Coordinate, don't just co-locate.
